notes.title: 11 New Levels and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we released our first update in Gravity Block.

We received feedbacks from players this weekend and with that we made bug fixes. 

We also took the opportunity to add new levels. In this update we inserted 11 new levels and their respective achievements!

Thanks to all who are supporting us!

PS.: If you like our game, don't forget to give us a review. Thanks again!
